summary: Make gateway restarts singleton and prove day-long reliability
description: Audit evidence from 2026-07-19 shows every planned /restart can produce two immediate systemd restart cycles: exit status 75 already triggers RestartForceExitStatus while a transient planned-restart helper also calls systemctl restart. The default gateway also reached 22.1 GiB cgroup peak during heavy child workloads. Reconcile restart ownership, preserve graceful drain, correlate watchdog causes, and produce a bounded soak instead of relying on green process state.
acceptance: R1 one /restart request causes exactly one stop/start transition under user systemd; R2 graceful drain and restart-loop protection remain intact; R3 watchdog-triggered restarts record one machine-readable reason and cannot race or stack; R4 a 24-hour soak records PID lineage, restart count, Telegram heartbeat, provider/pool/pair-integrity errors, anon memory, tasks, and OOM events; R5 no unexplained restart, pool exhaustion, pair-integrity error, Telegram conflict, or OOM occurs during the soak.
verification: python3 -m pytest tests/gateway tests/hermes_cli -q && git diff --check
